html:
If you are arriving at Tan Son Nhat International Airport and need a private car pick up service to Ho Chi Minh City, Vietlook Travel offers a reliable, comfortable, and stress free door to door private transfer with an experienced local driver.

This service is suitable for international and domestic travelers who want a smooth arrival, avoid waiting, and travel privately after a long flight.

Meet and Greet Service at Tan Son Nhat International Airport

Upon your arrival at Tan Son Nhat International Airport, our driver will be waiting at the arrival hall with a welcome board displaying your full name, making it easy for you to recognize him.

Please provide us with your flight number, landing time, number of passengers, and your hotel name or destination in Ho Chi Minh City. Based on your information, we will arrange a suitable vehicle for your airport pick up.

After greeting you, the driver will assist with your luggage and escort you to the car for a direct transfer to your destination.

Flexible and Comfortable Airport Transfer

Our Ho Chi Minh Airport pick up private car service allows you to:

  • Travel directly from the airport to your hotel or address

  • Avoid taxi queues and crowded public transportation

  • Request short stops along the way if needed

  • Enjoy a quiet and private ride in the city

The transfer time from Tan Son Nhat International Airport to the city center usually takes around thirty to forty five minutes, depending on traffic conditions.

Professional Driver and Quality Vehicles

Vietlook Travel provides:

  • Experienced, polite, and punctual drivers

  • Clean, modern, and well maintained vehicles

  • Strong air conditioning and safety seat belts

  • Assistance with luggage at both pick up and drop off points

We offer sedan cars, sport utility vehicles, minivans, and luxury vehicles to suit different group sizes.

A baby seat is available free of charge upon request.
